examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
<tp-markdown>
  <script type="tp/markdown">
## A short document

This paragraph uses **Markdown**.

- Write content
- Add components
- Publish the page
  </script>
</tp-markdown>

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of a Markdown source file to fetch and render; relative paths resolve against the containing source document when available.

methods.name: setSafeMarkdown(source: string): Promise<void>
methods.description: Renders generated Markdown with restricted formatting and source-backed formulas only.

events.name: tp-markdown-rendered
events.description: Emitted after Markdown and its runtime extensions are rendered, or after a source/conversion error is displayed. This event alone does not indicate successful conversion.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-markdown>` element renders Markdown documents.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Reading | Read the displayed content and use its links and embedded controls. |
| Using the component | The component itself adds no editing or playback controls. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| Focused controls | Use each control’s standard keyboard interaction.  |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
